logic_errors.component: parent-owned executable hook, not detached CPU receipt auditor
logic_errors.description: The private profile selects remote_source_by_phase[phase] and appends it as --remote-source, while retaining one --remote-root. Actual025 uses --remote-root for remote actor code and its registered source snapshot; --remote-source is the existing weight checkpoint consumed by stream_server --source and rank1 probe --model. The documented phase-specific source directories are therefore sent to checkpoint consumers, not the remote actor. One unmodified actor code root cannot simultaneously match the seven distinct frozen schedule hashes. The current mock test validates syntax and local frozen source selection but does not assert these remote argument semantics.

actual_reproducer.method: Invoke actual supervisor025.guarded_run with an exact-manifest/phase TEST parent guard and injected runner; inside the runner parse and validate the actual emitted argv with pinned025 supervise.parser/validate_args and call pure ssh_argv/probe_options. Never execute the generated SSH command or producer run function.

logic_errors.required_narrow_repair: Select phase-specific immutable code snapshots through remote_root_by_phase -> --remote-root, retain a single remote_source -> --remote-source for the existing pinned weight checkpoint, and update the exact whitelist, documentation and mock assertions. No duplicated model copies should be required. Re-freeze source-bound manifests after the repair.
